```yaml
name: Fix Dependabot Security Vulnerabilities

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs at midnight every Monday
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  fix-dependabot-vulnerabilities:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Update Go dependencies
        run: |
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@0.45.0
          go get golang.org/x/sys@0.38.0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Update npm dependencies
        run: |
          npm update express@4.22.1
          npm install qs@^6.14.2 body-parser@^1.20.4
          npm update next@15.5.12 koa@3.0.3 js-yaml@4.1.1
          npm update eslint@8.57.1 eslint-config-next@15.5.12
          npm install --save-dev @types/node@latest

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high --json > audit-report.json

      - name: Check for vulnerabilities
        id: check_vulnerabilities
        run: echo "::set-output name=vulnerabilities::$(jq '.length' audit-report.json)"

      - name: Fail if vulnerabilities found
        if: ${{ steps.check_vulnerabilities.outputs.vulnerabilities != '0' }}
        run: echo "Found vulnerabilities. Please resolve them before merging." && exit 1

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add backend/services/bulkdata/http/go.mod backend/services/utils/socketio/package.json frontend/package.json
          git commit -m "chore: fix dependabot security vulnerabilities"
          git push origin main
```
